The '''Fusai sector''' was one of four [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Outer Zuma]] Region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="gamer9">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> Its [[Planet/Legends|planets]] included [[Fusai/Legends|Fusai]].
